description: A revised Wealth Blueprint Short clarifying emergency readiness versus long-term goals.

segments.on_screen: Can you pay for this fix now?
segments.text: Imagine your car breaks down. Can you cover the repair today?
segments.visual_intent: reveal CAR REPAIR object showing a stationary vehicle with an open hood, no motion or labels inside the image.

segments.text: Name that repair as your essential expense. Locate your reserve money immediately.
segments.visual_intent: identify CAR REPAIR object in close-up view, holding a READY RESERVE icon near the vehicle without animation or transfer effects.

segments.text: Check how to access it. Verify actual conditions before relying on that balance.
segments.visual_intent: show READY RESERVE object with three small question marks drawn beside it, no moving parts or filled containers in the static render.

segments.text: Label this emergency reserve separately from a future goal meant for later plans only.
segments.visual_intent: compare READY RESERVE object with FUTURE GOAL object side by side, showing distinct separation without any transfer lines or motion between them.

segments.text: Review the separation when your personal circumstances change unexpectedly in life.
segments.visual_intent: hold both READY RESERVE and FUTURE GOAL objects static, showing a review symbol overlaying them without internal movement or filling actions.

segments.text: Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose with clear financial boundaries today.
segments.visual_intent: show brand logo overlaying the scene, holding all objects in a final stable state without independent motion or new elements appearing inside the frame.

title: Your Emergency Fund Is Not an Investment
